title: Booking
description:
A partner booking. Returned by create, amend, cancel, and read.

When `status=CANCELLED`, `cancellationReason` is set and the record persists
for partner refund handling.

title.description: Denormalized product title at the time of booking.

time.description: Local clock time at the experience location.

cancellationReason.description:
Present when `status=CANCELLED`. Partner-initiated cancellations
(`DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}`) always set `CANCELLEDBYGUEST`; the
other values appear on bookings cancelled internally by the host,
admin, or marked as a no-show.

cancellationDeadline.description: Latest moment the booking can be cancelled for a full refund.

specialRequest.description: Free-text note from the guest, forwarded to the host.

mainGuest.description:
The main guest (traveller) on the booking. This is the lead traveller
supplied as `mainGuest` on create. Absent when no main guest is recorded.

phoneNumber.description: Absent when the main guest has no phone number on their profile.

host.description: Minimal host details for day-of identification.

phoneNumber.description: Absent when the host has no phone number on their profile.

BookingStatus.description:
Partner-facing booking lifecycle. Translated from the internal `TripStatus`
by a single mapper (`PartnerBookingStatus.fromTripStatus`).

v1 lifecycle (no holds — `POST /bookings` creates a CONFIRMED booking
directly):

| Partner status | From internal `TripStatus` |
|---|---|
| `CONFIRMED`  | `CONFIRMED`, `COMPLETED` |
| `CANCELLED`  | `CANCELLEDBYGUEST` / `HOST` / `ADMIN` / `HOSTNOSHOW` / `COUPON` (with `cancellationReason`) |

Internal statuses that belong to the guest negotiation flow (`PROPOSAL`,
`PAIDPROPOSAL`, `UNCONFIRMED`, `REJECTED`, `DELETED`) are not
partner-visible. `RESERVATION` / `TIMEDOUT` / `EXPIRED` cannot occur in
v1 because there is no reserve step.

instructions.description: Free-text guidance for finding the meeting spot.
